mechanism_narrative: A higher current CPIAUCSL (inflation index) is associated with lower S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as elevated inflation erodes real corporate earnings and increases the perceived risk of holding equities.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL is above the 75th percentile of its historical range (t-test p > 0.05 over 3-year rolling windows).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a restrictive monetary policy, which is associated with lower equity valuations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative in periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% (t-test p > 0.05 over 3-year rolling windows).

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) combined with a declining industrial production (INDPRO) signals an imminent economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE > 4.0 and INDPRO < 104 (t-test p > 0.05 over 3-year rolling windows).

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening regime (defined by FEDFUNDS > 4.0% and HOUST < 1400), the S&P 500 tends to underperform, leading to negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative in periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.0 and HOUST < 1400 (t-test p > 0.05 over 3-year rolling windows).

mechanism_narrative: A HOUST (housing starts) level below 1350 thousand units signals weak demand for residential construction, which is a leading indicator of economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when HOUST < 1350 (t-test p > 0.05 over 3-year rolling windows).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 (index 2017=100) signals a contraction in the manufacturing sector, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO < 100 (t-test p > 0.05 over 3-year rolling windows).

mechanism_narrative: A higher current RSAFS (residential sales) level is associated with stronger demand for housing, which is a leading indicator of economic health, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive when RSAFS is above the 75th percentile of its historical range (t-test p > 0.05 over 3-year rolling windows).

mechanism_narrative: A RSAFS (residential sales) level above 750000 million dollars signals strong housing demand, which is a leading indicator of economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when RSAFS > 750000 (t-test p > 0.05 over 3-year rolling windows).
